note: Weekly target = August monthly GA4 target x 7/30. Vesu remains excluded (still closed, no bookings or Google spend). Hong Kong booked 1,012 bookings against a 949 target (+6.6 percent), down 3.8 percent week on week from last week’s record 1,052 but still +15.8 percent year on year. Four venues beat target, led by Cantina (+81%), The Chinese Library (+35%), Shiro (+24%) and Hutong (+15%). Aqua HK (-22%) and Dim Sum Library (-19%) missed, and they are the same two venues behind on YTD (Aqua HK -7.3%, Dim Sum Library -7.6%); the other four are all double-digit percentages ahead. Aqua HK is the one to watch: its users fell 22.7 percent year on year this week, so the gap there is traffic rather than conversion. The portfolio is +6.1 percent ahead of its cumulative YTD target.
